title: Visit Bakkie Museum
supports: Museum's own visitor page describes prebooked bus/boat transport, personal museum interpretation, garden walk and lunch on an organised day trip; current listed package is EUR75 per person. No exact future price, journey time or opening date is promised in the app.
hidden_gem_rationale: The museum describes itself as a very small operation hosted by its founders, including descendant Marsha Mormon. Personal family-history interpretation of original plantation-era objects, arranged river access and a garden visit distinguish this intimate hosted experience from Paramaribo's main heritage circuit; it is not a renamed part of an existing catalogue attraction.

additional_sources.title: Museum Bakkie: Story of the Plantations
additional_sources.supports: Small staffing, founder/descendant hosts, original collection and family history.

additional_sources.title: Plantation Bakkie tour
additional_sources.supports: Independent bookable operator itinerary corroborates the bus/boat, museum, garden and full-day format; availability remains subject to booking.
